result.summary: The page is generally usable, but there are minor layout/content clipping issues in horizontally scrolling sections and a small accessibility concern with low-contrast placeholder text.

issues.description: The category filter row and 'Fastest near you' carousel show items clipped at the right edge, including a partially visible category chip and the truncated restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...'.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel affordance, inset/scroll padding, or ensure truncated labels use ellipsis gracefully rather than appearing accidentally cut off.

issues.description: Search placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a light background and may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase placeholder contrast or use a darker gray that meets WCAG contrast guidance while still appearing secondary.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is visibly cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' without an ellipsis in the visible area.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with ellipsis or reduce card width/count so restaurant names remain readable.
